scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @embed-os/contracts && npm run build -w @embed-os/domain
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @embed-os/api" "npm run dev -w @embed-os/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @embed-os/api && npm run build -w @embed-os/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
